facts.fact: Biometric Update reports RDC-Pass was launched as a national digital identity platform, implemented through a 20-year PPP signed June 2025 with Trident Digital Tech DRC Africa SAS and valued at $97.1 million by the Ministry of Planning, with a phased rollout beginning with technical audits and pilot testing.
